subject: New standards
body:
I've been reading about facial harmony. Max Stryker says it's a science. From today:

- Age 21 to 29.
- Within 3 miles.
- Non-smokers.
- Straight or bi.
- Heritage Party only.
- Fewer Y followers than me. I have 212.
- Earns 30,000 DOLR a year or less. I make 31,000.
- Body count 1 or under.
- 5'4" or under.
- No kinks listed.
- Canthal tilt +4° or more.
- Long hair.
- No glasses.
- No earrings.
- 130 lbs or under.

Same deal. Every swipe right or no pay.
